footnote_text: The shares are represented by restricted stock units (RSUs). Each RSU represents a contingent right to receive one share of the Issuer's Class A Common Stock upon settlement. The RSUs vest as to 50% on November 1, 2027, 25% on November 1, 2028 and 25% on November 1, 2029, subject to the reporting person's continuous service through each such vesting date (except as described in the Issuer's Current Report on Form 8-K filed on September 30, 2026).
